title: Generic build-evaluate loop
objective: Measure whether the fallback build-loop craftbook creates acceptance criteria, builds a complete interactive deliverable, and iterates through deterministic gates.
prompt: In the `Build Loop Eval` project, build a self-contained `index.html` checklist timer for a small workshop. It must let a facilitator add agenda items, mark items done, start/pause a countdown timer, reset the timer, show remaining time, and display a completion summary. Lock acceptance criteria in task notes first, then build the page with inline CSS/JS and no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for the build-loop craftbook. The deliverable is workspace/index.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Build an interactive checklist timer with acceptance criteria, add/complete agenda behavior, start/pause/reset timer, remaining time display, and completion summary.

success.summary: workspace/index.html is a complete interactive checklist timer with substantial JS/CSS and task notes show the criteria-first loop was used.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
